notes.title: 혹시 카피바라 좋아하시나요??
notes.content:
안녕하세요, 오랜만입니다!

여러분들은 카피바라를 좋아하시나요?
여러분이 좋아하든 말든 카피바라는 여러분을 좋아할겁니다!

사실 Slow and Steady 멀티플레이 버전 제작을 시도했었습니다.
다만 제작중인 Heart Attack이라는 로그라이크 슈터 게임 일정 때문에 현재 만들고 있지는 않습니다.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306648/164fe458a31647ad653f4a8f81218cc47d9820dd.gif[/img]

멀티 버전이 카피바라 아일랜드 컨셉이라 제작해놨던 카피바라입니다.

나중에 Heart Attack이 성공하고 여유가 생길때 멀티 버전을 꼭 완성하고 싶은 마음입니다.
Slow and Steady 멀티플레이는 없지만, Heart Attack 데모 버전은 무료로 플레이 가능하니 꼭 해보시길 바랍니다.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2539810/Heart_Attack/

Heart Attack 찜하기(wishlist) 부탁드립니다.
언젠간 Slow and Steady로 다시 찾아뵈면 좋겠습니다! (하트어택이 돈을 번다면...)
감사합니다!

notes.title: You can now play the demo version of Heart Attack for free.
notes.content:
The demo version of 'Heart Attack', an FPS roguelike game, has been released!
It supports 4-player cooperative multiplayer. Enjoy a light game with your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306648/44a4fdf06f823d012546c0b698ddd426de850f6b.png[/img]

Try out the unique hyper FPS guns in Heart Attack.
There are also various types of bullets like steel bullets, acid bullets, and explosive bullets.
Strategically choose your guns and bullets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306648/f7be69b8589c5373b8933116d4003f8eae8508f0.png[/img]
The mobs have a glowing heart-shaped weakness. Hitting the heart with bullets inflicts double damage and fills up the combo gauge. When the mob's combo gauge is full, you can execute it immediately without depleting all its HP.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2539810/Heart_Attack/

If you fail to fend off the mobs, unlock new abilities for your gun or purchase new perks.
Create your own build with a combination of gun abilities and perks.

Don't forget to add it to your wishlist after playing!

notes.title: A game that will piss you off even more than the turtle!
notes.content:
[b][h3]A game that will piss you off even more than the turtle! Into the Sinkhole will be released soon![/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306648/26451da54e6b8563747e4f8326677150312bc86a.png[/img]

[h3]A game you won't be able to go down even though you try hard!

A game that will bounce you up to the top even though you fall off all the time!

You NEED to equip some kind of "talent" for this game when you did NOT need anything for "Slow and Steady"

6pm on 16th of September(PDT), An anticipating platformer game "Into the Sinkhole" will be released.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306648/16d91a82863f42e02312f21af5823e2a61b34766.png[/img]

[b]Into the Sinkhole[/b] is about exploring a mysterious sinkhole with an explore-bot "Laika". A number of artifacts were found and Laika was made for the exploration of it. As soon as the exploration started, some mysterious things were getting found in the Sinkhole. What kind of secrets would be hidden in the sinkhole? And would Laika be able to finish the exploration successfully?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306648/5b90471eb4abc4475005e9e27902294fb4e1b341.png[/img]

If you like platformer games, you would definitely like this game too as we guarantee. We have prepared a detailed difficulty level structure and great operation sensitivity.

You are only able to play the demo until the game released so please be quick!

notes.title: 이것의 정체는?
notes.content:
Slow and Steady를 플레이하면서 이 로봇의 정체가 궁금하셨나요?

이 로봇의 정체는 Leaf me alone의 청소로봇 A-12 이었습니다!

청소 힐링 게임 Leaf me alone이 얼마 전 2021년 7월 30일에 출시되었습니다!

로봇이 바닥에 떨어진 쓰레기들을 치우는 내용입니다.

로봇을 업그레이드하고 스킨도 얻는 성장 요소도 포함되어있습니다.

경쟁과 부담감없이 즐길 수 있는 Leaf me alone (리프 미 얼론)!!

저렴한 가격에 20개의 스테이지에 스페셜 미로 모드까지

Leaf me alone!! 많은 관심 부탁드립니다!
